title: polypodium pedunculatum
intro: Polypodium pedunculatum, commonly known as Rock Polypody, is a species of fern native to the Himalayas and other parts of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium pedunculatum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may contribute to its ability to reduce pain and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
